There are no further developments in the matter.

entities.name: Emkayglobal Financial Services IFSC Private Limited
Emkay Global Financial Services Pte. Ltd

industry: Financial Services > Capital Markets > Stockbroking & Allied

operating_notes.text: Fees and commission income was ₹342.77 Cr in FY26 against ₹312.58 Cr in FY25, while fees and commission expense rose to ₹77.10 Cr from ₹30.04 Cr.
ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]BBB+ (Positive) for the company's NCDs vide report dated August 5, 2025, with no change during Q4FY26.
Debt-equity ratio rose to 0.24 at Mar-2026 from 0.15 a year earlier; debt service coverage fell to 2.73 from 10.98.
Of the ₹227.52 Cr preferential warrant issue, ₹66.88 Cr had been received by Mar-2026 (₹61.88 Cr in Q3FY26 and ₹4.99 Cr in Q4FY26), leaving ₹160.64 Cr uncalled.
FY26 visible revenue pipeline stands above ₹50 Cr.
Allotted 1,00,000 shares at ₹239.50 on warrant conversion to promoter Prakash Kacholia, receiving ₹1.80 Cr (balance 75%), leaving 5,50,000 warrants outstanding with him.

timeline.summary: Emkay Global allotted 3.78 lakh equity shares on warrant conversion by promoters, raising ₹6.79 Cr.
Emkay Global allotted 4.15 lakh equity shares to promoter Krishna Kumar Karwa upon warrant conversion, receiving balance consideration of ₹7.46 Cr.
2026-05-15: CARE Ratings' monitoring report for Q4FY26 showed ₹66.88 Cr of the ₹227.52 Cr preferential warrant issue received, with ₹160.64 Cr still uncalled and nil deviation from objects.
On 18 May 2026, Emkay Global reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹396.30 Cr (+10% YoY) and PAT of ₹15.20 Cr (-73% YoY).
Mr. Krishna Kumar Karwa and Mrs. Priti Karwa jointly with Mr. Raunak Karwa declared holding 54,79,100 Emkay Global shares on 31-Mar-2026, with no new encumbrances.
Emkay Global allotted 1,00,000 equity shares to promoter Prakash Kacholia on warrant conversion, receiving ₹1.80 Cr.
Shareholders approved Mr. Rajesh Shah (DIN: 06390775) as Non-Executive Independent Director for 5 years, effective 19th August 2026, via remote e-voting ending 13th October 2026.
Emkay Global received NSE listing approval for 100,000 equity shares issued upon conversion of preferential warrants to promoter Mr. Prakash Kacholia.
